run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-16T21:58:39Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy was produced by frontend returning HTTP 500 for /api/data because the frontend could not reach the ad service. frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client spans carry the exact error '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 100.70.197.56:8080', and 100.70.197.56:8080 is the ClusterIP of Service ad. Deployment ad was restarted at 21:59:59Z: ReplicaSet ad-785b4464f5 and pod ad-785b4464f5-9bshh were created, its container started at 22:00:01Z, and the previous pod ad-554b849958-w5fhc was killed at 22:00:01Z; the two ReplicaSet pod templates are identical apart from kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-16T21:59:59Z. ad's own oteldemo.AdService/GetAds server spans dropped to ~0 from about 22:02 to about 22:09 and recovered at 22:10, exactly the interval in which frontend's GetAds calls were refused. The ad container has no readinessProbe and the new pod's Ready condition was True at 22:00:01Z, one second after the container started, so the Service had an endpoint that was not yet listening. frontend's calls to cart, checkout, product-catalog and recommendation recorded no error spans, the frontend and frontend-proxy pods have 0 restarts, and no node shows pressure, so the failure is localized to the ad workload rollout rather than to the alerted proxy or to the platform.

claims.text: frontend-proxy ingress ERROR span counts (10-minute increase) were background-level 0-6.32 for the points 21:38:39-21:58:39, then 188.42 (window ending 22:03:39), 430.53 (ending 22:08:39), 250.53 (ending 22:13:39) and 4.48 (ending 22:18:39).

The frontend-proxy ERROR spans are HTTP 500 on span_name 'ingress' with matching HTTP 500 error spans on 'router frontend egress', i.e. the 5xx came from the proxied frontend; the load-generator client spans in the same traces also record http.status_code 500.

frontend's ERROR spans in the window are on span_name 'GET /api/data', 'executing api route (pages) /api/data', 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' and one 'tcp.connect' series, while frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem, CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and RecommendationService/ListRecommendations spans have 0 ERROR spans.

The frontend GetAds client span records rpc.grpc.status_code=14 and grpc.error_message '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 100.70.197.56:8080'; the parent span 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' records the same exception with HTTP 500.

Service ad in namespace otel-demo has clusterIP 100.70.197.56 (port 8080 -> targetPort 8080, selector opentelemetry.io/name=ad); its Endpoints object lists one address, 100.96.3.224, and no notReadyAddresses.

ad's own oteldemo.AdService/GetAds server spans (2-minute increase) were 53-91 per point until 22:01:00, fell to 1.33 at 22:02:00 and 0 at every point from 22:03:00 through 22:09:00, then returned to 76 at 22:10:00 and 64-80 afterwards.

frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds spans show about 65-95 ERROR and 0 UNSET per 2-minute window from 22:02:00 through 22:09:00, then 0 ERROR / 32 UNSET at 22:10:00 and 0 ERROR / 72 UNSET at 22:11:00, i.e. all ad calls failed for roughly eight minutes and then succeeded again.

Kubernetes events show Deployment ad ScalingReplicaSet (scale up) at 21:59:59Z, ReplicaSet ad-785b4464f5 SuccessfulCreate at 21:59:59Z, pod ad-785b4464f5-9bshh Scheduled 21:59:59Z / container Created 22:00:00Z / Started 22:00:01Z, pod ad-554b849958-w5fhc Killing at 22:00:01Z and ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 SuccessfulDelete at 22:00:01Z.

The two ad ReplicaSets have identical pod templates except the annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-16T21:59:59Z; both use image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad, and ad-785b4464f5 has replicas 1 while ad-554b849958 has replicas 0.

Deployment ad's container has no readinessProbe and no livenessProbe (both null), generation 2, env AD_PORT=8080, resources limits cpu 50m / memory 450Mi; the deployment uses RollingUpdate maxSurge 25% / maxUnavailable 25% with minReadySeconds unset.
ad pod ad-785b4464f5-9bshh has Ready and ContainersReady conditions True at 2026-11-16T22:00:01Z, one second after its container Started at 22:00:01Z, with restartCount 0 and phase Running.

The ad Deployment restart at 21:59:59Z replaced the only serving ad backend: ad emitted effectively no GetAds server spans from about 22:02 to about 22:09, the same interval in which frontend's GetAds calls were refused at the ad ClusterIP, and this is what produced the frontend /api/data HTTP 500s that appear as frontend-proxy ingress errors in the alert.
frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-x27kw is Running with restartCount 0, and all 21 pods listed in otel-demo are in phase Running.

ad's only ERROR spans in the window are flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream (about 1.05 per 10 minutes at the 21:58:39 and 22:03:39 points); ad's oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and getAdsByCategory/getRandomAds spans carry STATUS_CODE_UNSET, so no application-level GetAds error is recorded on the ad side.
At query time all five nodes report Ready=True with MemoryPressure=False, DiskPressure=False and PIDPressure=False.

The flagd-config ConfigMap (data key demo.flagd.json) currently sets flag 'adFailure' to state ENABLED with defaultVariant 'on' and description 'Fail ad service'; adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure all default to 'off'.

fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-zzt65 has restartCount 1 with last termination reason OOMKilled (exit 137) finishedAt 2026-11-16T21:34:37Z and is now Ready and Running; frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans show 0 ERROR spans across the window, so fraud-detection is not on this failure path.

The likely mechanism inside that rollout is that the new ad pod was declared Ready at 22:00:01Z despite having no readinessProbe, before the ad application had bound port 8080, so the Service's single endpoint refused connections until the app began serving around 22:09; why the restarted ad container needed several minutes before serving (for example JVM cold start under the cpu 50m limit, or flagd initialisation) is not shown by any evidence retrieved in this Run.

frontend-proxy, the service the alert names, shows no fault of its own: its only ERROR spans are the 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' HTTP 500s that mirror frontend's responses, and its pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-kxdcl is Running with restartCount 0, so the alerting entity is a propagation point rather than the origin.

The flagd flag 'adFailure' (defaultVariant 'on') is not supported as the cause of this alert: the failure text is a transport-level 'connect ECONNREFUSED 100.70.197.56:8080' at the ad Service ClusterIP rather than an application gRPC status, and ad's GetAds server spans resumed normally around 22:10 while the ConfigMap still shows the flag 'on' at query time.

Add a readinessProbe (TCP 8080 or a gRPC health probe) to the ad container so the Service only sends traffic to a pod whose listener is up; this is the setting whose absence allowed the 21:59:59Z rollout to route callers to a non-listening pod.

Investigate why the restarted ad container needed several minutes before serving (cold start under the cpu 50m limit, flagd initialisation) and consider raising the CPU limit and adding a startupProbe so future restarts do not open an outage window.

Identify the actor or pipeline that applied kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-16T21:59:59Z to Deployment ad, and review why flagd-config currently declares adFailure as 'on' even though the ad service is serving again.

gaps: Change history is not an integrated data source in this Run, so what or who triggered the ad Deployment restart at 21:59:59Z cannot be determined.

Endpoint/EndpointSlice history is unavailable: the endpoint state of Service ad between 22:00 and 22:09 is inferred from the refused connections at the ClusterIP and from ad's missing server spans, and only the current Endpoints object (one address, 100.96.3.224) was observed.

The alert rule RequestErrorRate could not be read: list_prometheus_rules returned no_data for rule_name=RequestErrorRate and for {severity="warning"}, so its expression and 'for' duration are unknown; the alert start 21:58:39Z precedes the observed deviation and small non-zero ingress error counts existed before it.

kube-state-metrics series such as kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready returned no_data for this target, and get_metric_names found only traces_span_metrics_calls_total and traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket for service_name frontend-proxy, so replica/readiness history for Deployment ad could not be measured.

Why the restarted ad container did not serve for several minutes after starting is unknown: the ad container's retained stdout begins at 22:10:09Z with request-handling lines only, and the fetch of ad logs for 22:00-22:03 returned no_data (340 retained lines all fall after that window).

flagd has no series in traces_span_metrics_calls_total (query returned no_data), so its own health during 22:00-22:09 could not be assessed; only ad's flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream ERROR spans were visible.
The flagd-config values are current state only; the flag values in force at 21:59-22:09 are unknown.

A narrow Jaeger search (frontend, error=true, GetAds, 22:07:30-22:08:50) returned no traces, and Jaeger keeps only the most recent 5000 traces, so the exact end of the error burst is bounded by metrics rather than traces.

fraud-detection logs for 21:30-22:20 returned no_data (no line matched error|fail|exception|panic|Killed|OOM, and the read confirmed no such lines), so the earlier OOMKill at 21:34:37Z and the repeated Created/Started events at 22:06:49Z could not be explained from logs; those events remain unplaced, though checkout calls recorded no errors.
The frontend container's log stream returned no_data for 21:55-22:20, so frontend-side runtime errors are evidenced only by its trace spans.
Secrets and their values cannot be read, so any credential-dependent configuration is unverified.
next_steps: Obtain the change/audit record for the kubectl rollout restart of Deployment ad at 2026-11-16T21:59:59Z (who or what issued it).
Review the ad container's startup behaviour (cpu limit 50m, no readinessProbe, no startupProbe) and its flagd initialisation to explain the delay before it accepted connections.
Confirm with the owner whether flagd-config 'adFailure' is intentionally left 'on' and whether the ad service honours it, since it is the only fault-declaring setting currently enabled.
Inspect the Alertmanager/Prometheus rule for RequestErrorRate (not readable in this Run) to confirm the threshold and evaluation window that fired at 21:58:39Z.
